identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study of Utidelone Injection in Patients With Advanced or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Open, Multicenter, Monotherapy, Phase II Clinical Study of Utidelone Injection in Patients With Advanced or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer After Failure or Intolerability to Second-line Standard Treatment

statusModule.whyStopped: The efficacy evaluation (based on current data) deviated too much from results of previous clinical trials. It's assumed that high dropout rate of subjects, mainly due to covid-19 epidemic in China in the past 3 years, is the main reason.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To assess the effectiveness and safety of utidelone injection in patients with advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC) as a phase II trial

armGroups.label: utidelone
armGroups.description: Utidelone Injection: 40 mg/m2/day, IV transfusing over 90 min. on day 1-day 5 of each 21 day cycle, administered to enrolled patients with advanced or metastatic CRC

interventions.name: utidelone injection
interventions.description: utidelone monotherapy in patients with advanced or metastatic CRC by iv transfusing utidelone injection

primaryOutcomes.description: Reflected by percentage of tumor size reduction or regression, assessed by imaging techniques and expressed as Objective Response Rate (ORR）ORR is defined as the proportion of patients with a best overall response of Complete Response (CR) or Partial Response (PR) according to RECIST. 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the duration of time from first study treatment to disease progression or death from any cause as documented by the investigator
OS is defined as the duration of time from first study treatment until death from any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety profile associated with utidelone injection
secondaryOutcomes.description: Observe and record adverse effects and severe adverse effects associated with utidelone injection

locations.facility: The Sixth Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University
National Cancer Center/Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences
